sequenceDiagram
    participant Eva as Eva Janssen
    participant RP as the returns portal
    participant OMS as the OMS
    participant AV as the availability service
    participant PN as PostNL
    participant WMS as the WMS
    participant PL as the platform
    participant PSP as the PSP
    participant ERP as the ERP
    Eva->>RP: Exchange jacket M for L, too small, 19 April
    RP->>OMS: Read order 1072455 and eligibility
    OMS->>AV: Is L moss available for NL
    AV-->>OMS: Yes, one unit committed
    RP->>OMS: Create return R-20270419-1 and held order 1072455-X1
    RP-->>Eva: Return label and instructions
    OMS->>WMS: Expected return with reference
    Eva->>PN: Drop-off at parcel point, 20 April
    PN-->>OMS: Accepted, in transit, delivered to Duiven
    WMS->>WMS: Receive, inspect, grade resellable, 22 April
    WMS->>AV: Stock event on-hand plus one M moss
    WMS->>OMS: Return received, disposition restock
    OMS->>WMS: Release held order 1072455-X1, fulfillment order
    WMS->>PN: Label and parcel, 22 April
    OMS-->>Eva: Exchange shipped with tracking
    OMS->>ERP: Return settled, exchange shipped
    ERP->>ERP: Credit note and new invoice, net zero
    Note over OMS,PSP: Refund variant instead of the exchange
    OMS->>PL: Refund 199 euro keyed on R-20270419-1
    PL->>PSP: Refund request
    PSP-->>PL: Refund received, then refunded or failed days later
    PL-->>OMS: Refund state
